# E097 -- Sony Electronics USA Brand Identity Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Brand**: Sony Electronics (USA)
- **Industry**: Consumer Electronics
- **Year**: 2007 (Version 03)
- **Source file**: `69a0ef32389c0f07ba9de0e0c384e882.pdf`
- **Pages reviewed**: 1-2, 3-7, 12-13
- **Total pages**: 100

## Brand Strategy
- **Tagline**: "If it's not Sony, it's not the best." (historical reference)
- **Brand personality**: "Smart, but not intellectual. Confident, but not arrogant. Entertaining, but not shallow. Premium, but not out of reach. Cool, but not trendy. Iconic, but not intimidating. Simple, but not simplistic."
- **Name origin**: "Sony" crosses Latin sonus (sound/sonic) with English "sonny" (suggesting a young, energetic company). Created because Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo was unpronounceable; needed to be simple, memorable, immediate impact, transcend language barriers.
- Four fixed foundation elements: Sony logo, open frame, Sony black, taglines.

## Logo
- **Current logo**: designed in 1973 by design director Norio Ohga. Survived a 1981 redesign attempt (35th anniversary); Ibuka decided no submissions were better.
- Logo described as "the heart and soul of this company" and "our biggest asset."
- Must be given "protection and prominence" -- all communication must stress Sony above all else.
- Positioning: top right corner of open frame, 2h from top and right edge.
- Logo size formula: h = 0.022 x height of format.

## Color
- Dedicated color section (page 33+).

- Tagline color: 47% black (0C/0M/0Y/47K).

## Graphics
- **The Open Frame**: the defining graphic device of the Sony brand. A bordered frame area set apart from the page where product and message "slide onto the page seamlessly."
  - Differentiation rationale: "Most communication from competition uses full-bleed page layouts."
  - Metaphor connection: VAIO frames interface, Cyber-shot frames pictures, BRAVIA is itself a frame.
  - Precise mathematical construction rules: proportions based on logo height (h), top bar 4.35h, left bar 4.35h, bottom bar 5h.
  - Logo positioned 2h from top-right corner.
  - Tagline positioned halfway up bottom bar, flush left from inner edge, at 0.5h size.

## Tone of Voice
- Not a dedicated section, but brand personality defines tonal boundaries through paired opposites (smart/not intellectual, confident/not arrogant, etc.).

## Outliers
- **The Open Frame** is an exceptionally well-theorized and precisely specified graphic device -- complete with mathematical formula, metaphorical rationale (framing as a brand concept), and differentiation logic.
- **Brand personality as paired contradictions** is a distinctive and sophisticated approach: each trait is bounded by what it is AND what it is not.
- Historical narrative is rich: name origin story, 1973 logo design, 1981 preservation decision.
- Document is from 2007 (InDesign CS) but the design system feels timeless.
- Sony Black is a custom CMYK mix (not pure black) -- shows attention to print craft.
- 100 pages covering foundation, building guidelines, print, and environments.

## Quality Score
4/5 -- Thoughtfully constructed guidelines with the Open Frame as a distinctive, well-specified brand device. Strong brand personality articulation through paired opposites. Rich historical context. Comprehensive print and environment coverage. Minor deduction for age (2007) and lack of dedicated TOV/digital sections reflecting modern needs.
